name: tree-sitter-wasms
packLicenseNote: The Unlicense covers ONLY the pack's build scripts and packaging; every grammar wasm keeps its upstream licence, enumerated per-grammar below (each verified against npm registry metadata 2026-07-20).
provenance: npm maintainer 'greeggoor' == the repository author (github.com/Gregoor/tree-sitter-wasms); published 2025-10-07; tarball sha512 pinned from the registry integrity field (verified 2026-07-20). The sourcegraph/tree-sitter-wasms fork does NOT publish this package.

grammars.sourceProvenance: official upstream release asset, tag 0.7.3 published 2026-06-01, pinned 2026-08-31 (licence MIT re-verified against the tag's LICENSE the same day): the pack's own swift build (0.4.0-era) fatally OOMs V8's optimizing wasm compiler on load (turboshaft WasmLoweringPhase Zone OOM after a successful parse; node 24.20.0 exit 133/SIGTRAP on macOS, exit 3 on Windows) and killed the host until the FC-010 audition fence quarantined it; the 0.7.1/0.7.2/0.7.3 upstream release wasms all pass the same disposable-child audition clean under node

notes: REJECTED from this pack (census evidence, 2026-07-20): tree-sitter-yaml.wasm (C++ external scanner detonates at parse on the @vscode runtime — ABI mismatch) and tree-sitter-lua.wasm (scanner misparses valid code, e.g. `local x = 1`); re-sourcing them is S2b work. Update procedure: bump version+url, run scripts/vendor/fetch-grammars.ts --force, re-pin sha512 + per-file sha256 from its output, re-verify each upstream licence, re-run scripts/language-sidecars/prove-grammar-census.ts. A grammar entry may carry sourceUrl + sourceProvenance: its wasm then comes from THAT pinned https artifact instead of the pack tarball (same per-file sha256 law; swift rides the upstream 0.7.3 release asset because the pack's 0.4-era build fatally OOMs V8's optimizing wasm compiler — audition-fenced, see the registry's fragile marking). The ordinary build consumes ONLY the verified local cache (vendor/grammars/extracted) or produces an honest degraded manifest.
